### Evaluation

You fill a 20-minute form. We tell you in writing whether it’s worth taking to buyers.

- 20-minute form: systems, years, rough counts

- No files, no logins, no customer data

- Written yes / no / follow-up within one business day

- If it isn’t worth taking to buyers, we say so and stop. You owe nothing.
